<subject>coordination with Kalgoorlie</subject>
<body>
I had a conversation with Bryan Wilson and Cynthia Calhoun this morning re: Rail Logistics and the Kalgoorlie process.

Bryan has generated both an in and out-of-the-money list which he will forward so that Port Hedland can review for counterparty termination accuracy.  I think that Kalgoorlie can use our newly established processes as a template.  Bryan and others will participate in the 9:30 a.m. conference call Feb 5.

John and Randy:  Can you provide Bryan with a copy of the "Pilbara Iron Ore" template, or if this has been replaced, a copy of the most recent template?  Also, the "Northern Mining" template?

Kyle:  Can you provide Bryan and Meredith Green with a copy of the decision tree and settlement process flowchart?

If the handouts for tomorrow will be ready and incorporate the above, the handouts are all that Kalgoorlie will need.

Thanks.  SS

Katrina Howell
Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd
1400 Hay Street, Room 26B43
Perth, WA  6000
Ph:  +61 8 0011 5961
